tokyo_dozeu_iidaya.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from the shop's own おしながき page, which states ※価格はすべて税抜きです (prices exclude tax); the shop's English page contradicts this and says tax included, so expect roughly 10% on top. Checked 2026-08-20.

items.en: Loach hotpot — whole dojo loaches simmered at your table in sweet soy broth; bury them under the box of raw spring onion and eat as it wilts. Shichimi and sansho from Asakusa Yagenbori sit on the table
items.note: 割下（醤油・味醂ベース）＝小麦。The sweet-soy simmering broth is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Boned loach hotpot — the loaches are split and boned first; the gentler version for a first-timer
items.note: 同じ割下（醤油）＝小麦。Same wheat-soy broth.

items.en: Yanagawa-nabe — boned loach and shaved burdock simmered in sweet soy, finished with beaten egg
items.note: 割下＝醤油、卵とじ。Wheat-soy broth, egg-bound.

items.en: Catfish hotpot — winter only
items.note: 割下＝醤油。冬季限定 — winter months only.

items.en: Grilled loach, kabayaki style — split, skewered and basted with sweet soy tare
items.note: 蒲焼のタレ＝醤油。Kabayaki tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Grilled eel, kabayaki style — glazed with sweet soy tare
items.note: 「4,000円より」＝ from ¥4,000; price varies with the eel. 蒲焼のタレ＝醤油。

items.en: Plain-grilled eel, no glaze — eaten with wasabi and soy on the side
items.note: 焼き自体はタレなしだが、つけ醤油が付く。The fish is grilled unglazed; only the dipping soy is wheat — ask to have it left off.

items.en: Grilled catfish, kabayaki style
items.note: 時価 = market price, ask on the day. 蒲焼のタレ＝醤油。

items.en: Loach rice bowl — essentially the nabe over rice
items.note: 割下＝醤油。

items.en: Maiko-don — the house loach-and-egg rice bowl
items.note: 割下＝醤油、卵とじ。

items.en: Grilled eel over rice in a lacquer box
items.note: 蒲焼のタレ＝醤油。

items.en: Grilled eel over rice, top grade — more eel
items.note: 蒲焼のタレ＝醤油。

items.en: Eel and egg rice bowl
items.note: 醤油ダレ＋卵。Soy tare plus egg.

items.en: Chicken and egg rice bowl — the cheapest full bowl on the board
items.note: 出汁と醤油で煮る。Simmered in bonito dashi and wheat soy sauce; egg.

items.en: Egg rice bowl — onion and egg simmered in dashi over rice
items.note: 出汁と醤油。Dashi and wheat soy sauce; egg.

items.en: Eel chazuke — eel over rice with hot broth poured on
items.note: タレと出汁。Tare and bonito dashi.

items.en: Seaweed chazuke — the cheap, comforting end-of-meal bowl
items.note: 出汁・調味の内容未記載。Broth composition not published — normally dashi plus soy. Ask.

items.en: Plain steamed rice
items.note: 白飯のみ、調味なし。Plain white rice, nothing added.

items.en: Pickles
items.note: 漬け床不明。Pickling medium not published — Japanese pickles often carry soy or mirin. Ask.

items.en: Shaved burdock — the standard extra to pile into the loach pot
items.note: 鍋の割下に入る＝醤油。Goes into the wheat-soy pot.

items.en: Tofu — an extra for the pot
items.note: 鍋の割下に入る＝醤油、魚の出汁。Added to the wheat-soy loach pot.

items.en: Egg — an extra for the pot
items.note: 生卵。Raw egg to bind the pot.

items.en: Loach miso soup — made with 江戸甘味噌 Edo sweet miso; rich but clean-finishing, with the bitterness of the whole loach as the accent
items.note: 江戸甘味噌は通常米味噌だが原材料未記載。Edo sweet miso is normally a rice miso, but the shop publishes no ingredients — ask, since a 麦味噌 barley miso would be gluten. Loach stock, not vegan.

items.en: Boned-loach miso soup
items.note: 同じ江戸甘味噌。Same miso question; loach stock.

items.en: Nameko mushroom miso soup
items.note: 味噌と鰹出汁。Miso plus bonito dashi — ask which miso; the dashi rules out vegan.

items.en: Egg soup
items.note: 出汁と卵。Dashi and egg.

items.en: Tofu miso soup
items.note: 味噌と鰹出汁。Miso plus bonito dashi.

items.en: Eel-liver clear soup — the traditional partner to una-ju
items.note: 吸い地は出汁＋薄口醤油が一般的。Clear broth normally uses light soy — ask. Eel liver.

items.en: Grilled eel with grated mountain yam
items.note: 蒲焼のタレ＋とろろの出汁割り。Kabayaki tare plus dashi-thinned yam.

items.en: Nanban-zuke — small loaches deep-fried whole without batter, then steeped in the shop's own blend of soy, vinegar and mirin. Crisp, sweet-sour, and the dish the shop itself points beer drinkers at
items.note: 醤油・酢・みりんの漬けダレ＝小麦。素揚げでも共用フライヤー。Soy-based marinade; unbattered, but the fryer is shared.

items.en: Deep-fried loach
items.note: 唐揚げ＝粉の衣、共用フライヤー。Flour-dusted and deep-fried; shared fryer.

items.en: Nuta — bluefin tuna dressed in a secret miso passed only to the okami, with wakame, udo and jellyfish. Salty and strongly flavoured; built for sake and rice
items.note: 秘伝の味噌の種類が非公開。The house miso is a family secret and unpublished — ask whether it is a barley miso. Contains fish and jellyfish.

items.en: Uzaku — grilled eel and cucumber in vinegar dressing
items.note: 蒲焼＋三杯酢（醤油）。Kabayaki eel plus soy-based vinegar dressing.

items.en: Savoury steamed egg custard
items.note: 出汁に薄口醤油が入るのが一般的。Dashi custard, normally seasoned with light soy — ask. Egg and dashi.

items.en: Grated mountain yam, usually over tuna
items.note: 出汁割りとつけ醤油。Yam thinned with dashi and eaten with soy — ask.

items.en: Tsukimi — grated yam with a raw egg yolk dropped in like a moon
items.note: 生卵。Raw egg; dashi and soy seasoning likely.

items.en: Rolled omelette, sweet dashi style
items.note: 出汁巻きの出汁に醤油が入ることが多い。Dashi-rolled omelette usually carries soy — ask. Egg.

items.en: Oyako-yaki — rolled omelette with chicken folded in
items.note: 同上、鶏肉入り。Same as above, plus chicken.

items.en: Itawasa — sliced kamaboko fish cake with wasabi and soy
items.note: かまぼこの調味料と、つけ醤油。Fish cake plus wheat soy to dip.

items.en: Broad beans in the pod
items.note: 塩茹でが一般的だが調味未記載。Normally just salt-boiled, but the seasoning is not published — ask.

items.en: Bottled beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Draught beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Yebisu beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Sake — Gekkeikan, by the flask
items.note: 日本酒は米と米麹だが、店は原材料表示を出していない。Sake is rice and rice koji; no allergen line published here, so ask if you are strict.

items.en: Cedar-cask sake — Kikumasamune
items.note: 杉樽で香りを付けた米の酒。Cask-scented rice sake; same caveat as above.

items.en: Unpasteurised sake — Gekkeikan
items.note: 米の酒。Rice sake, unpasteurised.

items.en: Ginjo sake — Tateyama, Toyama
items.note: 米の酒。Rice sake.

items.en: Junmai sake — Yoshidagura, Ishikawa
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。Junmai is rice and rice koji only, but no allergen statement is published here.

items.en: Barley shochu — Kurowara, sold by the bottle
items.note: 麦＝大麦。Barley. This is the bottle price, not a glass.

items.en: Chilled Western spirit, house pour
items.note: 銘柄未記載。Brand unpublished; at a shop this old the house Western spirit is whisky, i.e. barley. Treat as gluten unless staff name something else.

items.en: Soft drink / juice
items.note: 果汁飲料。Fruit juice — no wheat, no barley, no animal ingredient.
